info.title: kling/kling-v3-omni
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "kling/kling-v3-omni", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for a Kling omni-video generation. The `example` below is the COMFY ROUTER form and deliberately omits `model_name`, which Router fills from the `{model}` path segment; a direct v1 call to POST /proxy/kling/v1/videos/omni-video may add it (the proxy defaults an absent one to kling-video-o1). One example cannot serve both spellings, so the omitting form is the only one valid on both Router routes.

example.prompt: A paper boat drifting down a rain-soaked street at dusk.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video frame (width:height). Required when first-frame reference or video editing features are not used.

callback_url.description: The callback notification address for the result of this task. If configured, the server will actively notify when the task status changes. Ignored: comfy-api drops this field before forwarding; Comfy Router polls on your behalf.

duration.description: Video Length in seconds. When using video editing function (refer_type: base), output duration is the same as input video and this parameter is invalid.

element_list.description: Reference Element List based on element ID configuration.

external_task_id.description: Customized Task ID. Must be unique within a single user account. Ignored: comfy-api drops this field before forwarding; Comfy Router polls on your behalf.

image_list.description: Reference Image List. Can include reference images of the element, scene, style, etc., or be used as the first or last frame to generate videos.

image_url.description: Image Base64 encoding or image URL (ensure accessibility). Supported formats include .jpg/.jpeg/.png. File size cannot exceed 10MB. Width and height dimensions shall not be less than 300px, aspect ratio between 1:2.5 ~ 2.5:1.

type.description: Whether the image is in the first or last frame. first_frame is the first frame, end_frame is the last frame. Currently does not support only the end frame.

mode.description: Video generation mode. std: Standard Mode, generating 720P videos, cost-effective. pro: Professional Mode, generating 1080P videos, higher quality video output.

model_name.description: Model name. Omit it or send null when using Comfy Router; the model is selected by the request path. A supplied name must match that path.

multi_prompt.description: Information about each storyboard, such as prompts and duration. Supports up to 6 storyboards, with a minimum of 1. Required when multi_shot is true and shot_type is customize.

duration.description: Duration of this storyboard in seconds. Must not exceed total task duration and must not be less than 1. Sum of all storyboard durations equals total task duration.

prompt.description: Prompt word for this storyboard. Maximum length 512 characters.

multi_shot.description: Whether to generate multi-shot video. When true, the prompt parameter is invalid. When false, the shot_type and multi_prompt parameters are invalid.

prompt.description: Text prompt words, which can include positive and negative descriptions. Must not exceed 2,500 characters. Can specify elements, images, or videos in the format <<<>>> such as <<element_1>>, <<<image_1>>>, <<<video_1>>>.

shot_type.description: Storyboard method. Required when the multi_shot parameter is set to true.

sound.description: Whether sound is generated simultaneously when generating videos.

video_list.description: Reference Video list. Can be used as a reference video for feature or as a video to be edited, with the default being the video to be edited.

keep_original_sound.description: Whether to keep the video original sound. yes indicates retention, no indicates non retention.

refer_type.description: Reference video type. feature is the feature reference video, base is the video to be edited.

video_url.description: URL of uploaded video. Only .mp4/.mov formats are supported. Duration between 3-10 seconds. Resolution must be between 720px and 2160px. Frame rates of 24-60 fps supported. Only 1 video can be uploaded, with size not exceeding 200MB.

watermark_info.description: Whether to generate watermarked results simultaneously. Custom watermark is not supported at this time.

enabled.description: true means generate watermark, false means do not generate.
